request: End user must understand why a repository or set is more useful for their project technical, architectural and product goals.
scope: Prospective explanation/composition guidance and same-capture advisory examples; no retrieval tuning, schema/policy change, or runtime activation claim.
success_criteria: Confirmed goal and project constraint are distinguished from unknowns.
Source-supported capability explains mechanism and expected project benefit; unmeasured benefit is a hypothesis.
Conditional comparison explains preference and when it reverses.
Architecture placement, integration cost and set member roles are explained or explicitly unknown.
A concrete next check resolves a decision-changing uncertainty.
RU/EN preserves facts, uncertainty, roles and proposed status; plain language is persona-appropriate.
risks: Invented project architecture or unsupported capability
Generic superiority without an alternative or constraint
Redundant stack components presented as a useful set
Hypothetical time/cost/performance improvement presented as measured
